name: Phase Diagrams
summary: Teaches how to read and construct equilibrium phase diagrams and use them to predict the microstructure of alloys and ceramics.

topics.name: Phases, components and microstructure; solubility limits
Binary isomorphous systems (Cu-Ni): liquidus, solidus, tie lines
The lever rule and phase compositions/amounts
Development of microstructure during equilibrium and non-equilibrium cooling (coring)
Binary eutectic systems (Pb-Sn): eutectic microstructures and hypo/hypereutectic alloys
Peritectic, monotectic, eutectoid and peritectoid reactions
The iron-carbon (Fe-Fe3C) phase diagram: ferrite, austenite, cementite and pearlite
Ceramic phase diagrams (Al2O3-Cr2O3, MgO-Al2O3, ZrO2-CaO, SiO2-Al2O3)
Ternary phase diagrams: isothermal and vertical sections, liquidus projections
Deriving phase diagrams from free-energy curves
Experimental determination of phase diagrams (thermal analysis, metallography, diffraction)
